scope: Visual inspection and render-only repair of Figure R2, all panels A–G. Scientific extraction, estimators, seeds, mode records and campaign settings unchanged.

viewed_artifacts.method: Direct view_image, initial and repaired full-colour PNG; 2125 × 3570 pixels, 300 dpi
Initial and final PDF rasterized with pdftoppm -scale-to 2200; raster visually inspected, including every panel
SVG XML inspected for text and clip paths; 225 editable text elements, no text element has a clip-path; all seven panel letters present
Grayscale diagnostic of final PNG visually inspected for shade separation and guide/marker visibility
Enlarged diagnostic crop of Goryachev E bounds visually inspected; open triangles and upward arrows clear
Fresh PDF raster from current committed renderer, visually inspected alongside current final PNG after source-hash reconciliation.

issues_and_fixes.issue: B and D rightmost tick labels ran beyond page; D also had crowded 10000/12000 ticks after alignment.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Reserve 2.5% right page margin, align edge tick labels inward, reduce D ticks to 0/4000/8000/12000.

issues_and_fixes.issue: A facets with and without a colourbar had different kymograph widths.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Identical dedicated colourbar column reserved in each facet; exact 20:60 width ratios preserved across all A/C pairs.

issues_and_fixes.issue: Activity scales used very small labels; Goryachev asinh endpoints were not legible in initial figure.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Dedicated narrow colourbars, explicit numerical endpoints with larger text, asinh label retained. Shared C20/C60 scale and all negative Fourier ringing preserved.

issues_and_fixes.issue: E/F/G keys shown only in the first model hue and overlapped some E bounds.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Neutral light-to-dark shared keys above their panel; E/F define triangle-plus-arrow bound and cross pending symbols. Model-specific hue ramps remain on data.

issues_and_fixes.issue: Gold light-series contrast was weak in print/grayscale.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Minimum ramp intensity increased from 0.4 to 0.5; inspected final full grayscale diagnostic.

issues_and_fixes.issue: Bound arrows were short/faint and obscured by E key.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Removed overlapping inset legend and explicitly set arrow head scale and zero endpoint shrink. Enlarged visual crop confirms open triangles and arrows.

issues_and_fixes.issue: Spring G annotation covered the upper datum and did not distinguish unavailable centre from pending outer size.
issues_and_fixes.fix: Annotation moved to empty central gap and dynamically labels pending outer sizes. Missing centre breaks the Spring line, so no connector implies an available centre. Actual mean circumference remains the data x coordinate; native model ticks are explicit.

panel_assessments.A: Pass. Three beta facets align; C20:C60 widths are exactly 1:3; time upward; supply/success labels legible; shared linear grayscale 0–1 shown.
panel_assessments.B: Pass. All three analytic facets readable; gray C20/C60 ramp and beta labels clear; 0/12000/24000 lag labels fully within page.
panel_assessments.C: Pass. Both model conditions legible; pair widths/time windows/scales shared; explicit asinh Goryachev scale −0.423–93.5 and linear Wave-pinning scale 0.15–2.05 readable. Faint C60 Goryachev background is retained evidence under the common scale.
panel_assessments.D: Pass. Model conditions, size curves, 95% bands, dotted no-size guide and dashed drift guide visible; ticks separated and unclipped. Fractional-power guide gaps at nonpositive C20 are retained.
panel_assessments.E: Pass for current pending snapshot. Four model facets share amplitude and exponent axes; gray guides recessive; rate shades keyed; observed Goryachev lower bounds are explicit open triangles with upward arrows; pending crosses remain separate from bounds.
panel_assessments.F: Pass for current pending snapshot. Six facets have consistent scales, model/rate labels, supply key and pending marks; no bound replaced by an ordinary point.
panel_assessments.G: Pass for current pending snapshot. Four native model x axes explicit, separate y ranges justified by distinct magnitudes; amplitude ramp and uncertainty bars clear. Spring size 1 visible, centre unavailable and size 3 pending stated; unavailable centre remains a line gap.

final_assessment: Visually satisfactory at the requested 180 mm width for this explicitly pending campaign snapshot. All panels inspected in PNG and PDF; grayscale and bound details inspected. This review applies to the hashes recorded here. When the campaign refresh changes plotted records, rerender from current source and inspect new marks before treating that refreshed figure as visually reviewed.
